title: Deeper deployment lessons and reproducible release checks
summary: Eight deployment and interoperability lessons now connect staged builds, numerical reasoning and changed-condition practice to one release dossier.
changes: Added staged builds to framework bridging, PyTorch-to-Flax parity, export, precision, containerization and edge deployment, completing the eight-lesson phase.
Added feature-order and activation checks, retention gates, elementwise error budgets, nonuniform gradient parity, and fresh-interpreter export validation.
Expanded raw-request and artifact validation, packed-weight storage accounting, percentile interpretation and request deadline exercises.
Added four explained conceptual figures and strengthened the phase completion evidence; CPU, container and device results retain separate scopes.

title: Clearer lessons, visible revisions and searchable chapters
summary: A course-wide teaching revision, with a recorded version for every lesson and phase.
changes: Expanded explanations and reasoning checks across all 97 authored lessons, with 22 concept diagrams and explanations of what each figure shows.
Added project organization and CLI guidance, expanded modality project plans, and preserved explicit CPU validation and TPU limitations.
Published a permanent HTML page for every authored lesson, search metadata and a sitemap.
Added lesson and phase revision labels, a release history, and notices when this browser encounters changed material. Your saved progress stays intact.
